title: COUNTX of an expression that is always BLANK is BLANK, not 0

source.quote: When the function finds no rows producing a non-blank value, it returns a blank.
source.supports: the page says COUNTX ( Customer, BLANK () ) returns BLANK

derivation: The expression is BLANK for every row, so nothing is counted and the result is BLANK.
notes: The column's type is not asserted: no source says what type an all-BLANK result has.
